name: azure-servicebus-dotnet
summary: 微软的这项技能涵盖 Azure Service Bus 的队列处理、主题订阅和死信处理，并提供在 ASP.NET Core 项目中通过依赖注入注册客户端的起点。文档中的配置使用 Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus 和 Azure.Identity 两个包。

Microsoft’s skill covers queue processing, topic subscriptions, and dead-letter handling with Azure Service Bus. It gives ASP.NET Core projects a starting point for wiring the client through dependency injection. The documented setup uses the Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus and Azure.Identity packages.
